highlights: AI agent capabilities are expanding with new self-hostable frameworks and transactional wallets, alongside critical research into agent reliability and error handling to inform more robust designs.

Frontier models are pushing performance boundaries with Google's Gemini 4 Hydrogen offering 2.5x speedups, Liquid AI's LiquidCodec enabling ultra-fast audio processing, and Perplexity enhancing open-weight decision models with span extraction.

Developer tools are seeing significant advancements in AI inference optimization, with Google's TPU Sync dramatically reducing KV cache transfer latency and Together Compiler boosting throughput for diverse AI workloads.

agents.title: CopilotKit Releases OpenBot 1.0: Self-Hostable AI Coworker with Governance
agents.summary: CopilotKit launched OpenBot 1.0, an MIT-licensed, self-hostable AI coworker workspace providing built-in governance and audit trails, enabling companies to integrate their own agents and models securely.

agents.title: AWS Releases AI-Built AWS Emulator for Local API Development
agents.summary: AWS introduced AWS Emulator, a free, CC0-licensed local emulator for over 200 AWS APIs, entirely built by autonomous AI agents, significantly accelerating development and testing for AWS users.

agents.title: Research: Cleaning Agent History Can Hurt If World Retains Errors
agents.summary: New research reveals that superficially cleaning an AI agent's history without addressing underlying world state errors can actually degrade recovery rates, emphasizing the need for robust error handling in agent design.

models.title: Google Releases Gemini 4 Hydrogen: 2.5x Faster Agentic Model
models.summary: Google launched Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a rapid agentic model featuring a 1M-token window and 4 thinking levels, demonstrating 2.5 times faster performance than its predecessor, Gemini 3.8 Flash.

models.title: Liquid AI Introduces LiquidCodec: 74M-Parameter Streaming Audio Codec
models.summary: Liquid AI released LiquidCodec, an efficient 74M-parameter streaming audio codec capable of encoding audio 361 times faster than real-time on a single CPU, enabling high-performance audio applications.

models.title: Perplexity Decider v1.3: Open-Weight Decision Models with Span Extraction
models.summary: Perplexity's Decider v1.3 and Flash v1.3 are open-weight decision models now featuring 'Locate' for span extraction, achieving 91.6% mean accuracy on query-classification tasks by returning probabilities instead of text.

tools.title: Google Releases TPU Sync: Open-Source KV Cache Transfer Library
tools.summary: Google introduced TPU Sync, an open-source C++ library for moving KV caches and weights efficiently across TPU HBM, host DRAM, storage, and network, reducing KV transfer latency by over 90% for large MoE models.

tools.title: Together Compiler: Continual Compilation for AI Inference Optimization
tools.summary: Together AI unveiled "Together Compiler," a novel continual agent loop designed for AI inference optimization, which significantly boosts TPS by up to 2.6x on frontier models across various hardware platforms.

tools.title: Google Launches Gemini Decisions API for Calibrated Multimodal Decisions
tools.summary: Google launched the Gemini Decisions API, powered by Gemini Decision 1, offering calibrated probabilities for up to 1,000 multimodal questions (text, image, audio, video, PDF) at $0.10 per 1M input tokens.

companies.title: OpenAI Introduces ChatGPT Wallet for Agent-Initiated Purchases
companies.summary: OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet, providing a secure method for agents in ChatGPT Work, Codex, and dots to complete purchases with user approval, enhancing agent utility and monetization potential.

companies.title: ChatGPT Enterprise Now Available in AWS Marketplace
companies.summary: ChatGPT Enterprise is now accessible through AWS Marketplace, simplifying procurement for organizations by leveraging existing AWS purchasing and billing relationships.

companies.title: Google Cloud Launches Gemini for Healthcare Solutions
companies.summary: Google Cloud announced Gemini for healthcare, designed to unify clinical data and automate workflows, aiming to reduce administrative burnout and enhance healthcare operations with AI.

learning.title: The Definitive Fine-Tuning Guide for 3D Generation Models Released
learning.summary: A comprehensive guide on fine-tuning 3D generation models has been published, offering crucial insights for developers and researchers working on advanced 3D content creation.

learning.title: Guide: Build Robot Pick-and-Place Simulation with SimReady Assets
learning.summary: A new guide demonstrates how to build robot pick-and-place simulations using SimReady Assets, providing practical steps for developers engaging in robotics and simulation projects.

learning.title: OpenAI Academy Offers Free AI Workshops for Caregivers
learning.summary: OpenAI Academy is conducting free, hands-on ChatGPT workshops in five U.S. cities to equip caregivers with practical AI skills for everyday life, promoting AI literacy and utility in the community.
